<subject>Mine Haulage Rates</subject>
<body>
ED:

A second Mine Haulage Rates question:

Tasman Ridge's logistics team wants the definition of "Applicable Haulage Rate"  to remain without changing to the Non-default Rate if the payee is the defaulting party.  They say they must have a "balanced rate".  Please let me hear from you.  Katrina
